summary: Task Grouping (Görev Bağlama) feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass covering create (with min-2 validation), list, patch (name/progress/membership replace + reorder + removed-member clearing + sort_order descending), remove-member (with auto-dissolve when <2 remain), and delete-group. Frontend: full UI flow verified — toolbar BAĞLA opens modal, adding >=2 tasks + name + progress toggle + Save creates group block with header, progress badge '0/2 tamamlandı', drag handle, edit button, dissolve button; right-click on ungrouped task shows 'Görevleri Bağla' and preselects that task; right-click on grouped task shows both 'Grubu Düzenle' and 'Gruptan Çıkar'; toggling a member's status updates progress badge to '1/2 tamamlandı'; edit modal is prefilled with the group name; dissolve button dissolves the group ('Grup bağlantısı çözüldü' toast) and tasks return as normal cards. No regressions observed on task list rendering, status toggle, task creation, or archive.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is very large (~3604 lines). Consider extracting TaskGroupBlock, OuterTaskRow, and the add-task form into separate files for maintainability.

dissolveGroup() has no user confirmation — a single accidental click on the small unlink icon irreversibly dissolves the group. Consider a lightweight confirm() (e.g. 'Grubu çözmek istediğinize emin misiniz?') to match user's regression-averse UX ('hiçbir şeyi bozma').

In backend create_task_group, sort_order uses hardcoded 1e6 base (float(1000000 - idx)); if user already had tasks with sort_order > 1000000 elsewhere the group members may appear below them. Consider anchoring to max(existing sort_order)+N or a per-group logical order field.
